national_news.title: PM Modi Holds 15 Bilateral Meetings on Sidelines of BRICS Summit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi conducted 15 bilateral meetings with heads of state and government during the BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
Key discussions covered cooperation in trade, defence, security, energy, critical minerals, and emerging technologies with leaders from Kazakhstan, Egypt, Indonesia, South Africa, and others.
PM Modi welcomed the Philippines' decision to join the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI).

national_news.title: Amit Shah Urges Industry to Capture Entire Value Chain of Lab-Grown Diamonds
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the 52nd India Gems and Jewellery Awards in Mumbai, emphasizing self-reliance across the entire lab-grown diamond ecosystem.
Stated that the volume of the lab-grown diamond market is expected to expand nearly 50 times compared to the current diamond market size.
Inaugurated a manuscript exhibition titled 'Shri Ganesh Dnyanarati' at the Asiatic Society of Mumbai to encourage manuscript conservation via modern technology.

national_news.title: Mizoram's Bairabi-Sairang Rail Line Completes One Year of Operations
bullets: Mizoram's 51.38-km Bairabi-Sairang rail line completed one year of operation, serving over 15 lakh passengers and transporting 2,500 freight wagons.
The engineering project includes 153 bridges (tallest rising up to 114 meters) and 45 tunnels spanning nearly 16 kilometres.
Direct train services to Delhi, Kolkata, and Guwahati have contributed to an 86% increase in Mizoram's tourism sector.

national_news.title: Bairabi-Sairang Railway Lifeline Transforms Logistics and Connectivity in Mizoram
bullets: The Ministry of Railways celebrated the one-year milestone of the 51.38 km Bairabi-Sairang railway line connecting Mizoram's capital threshold to the national railway network.
The route features 55 major bridges, 88 minor bridges, 10 overbridges/underbridges, with its tallest bridge standing 42 meters taller than the Qutub Minar.
Key operational services include the Sairang-Anand Vihar Rajdhani Express, Sairang-Kolkata, Sairang-Guwahati, and Sairang-Silchar passenger trains.

national_news.title: Rashtriya Raksha University Hosts BRICS AML/CFT Capacity Building Programme
bullets: Rashtriya Raksha University (RRU) hosted a five-day BRICS Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) training programme at its Lavad campus in Gujarat.
The programme aligns with commitments under the BRICS Kazan Declaration 2024 and Rio de Janeiro Declaration 2025 to strengthen cross-border financial security frameworks.
Discussions focused on FATF's 11 Immediate Outcomes, virtual asset risks, and India's high technical compliance in its 2024 FATF Mutual Evaluation.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Chairs BRICS Session on Inclusive Global Governance in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the BRICS session on 'Inclusive Global Governance and Strengthening Multilateralism' during the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
PM Modi advocated transforming the 'pyramid of privilege into a platform of partnership' and proposed establishing a 'Seafarers Emergency Support Network'.
The session concluded with the adoption of the New Delhi BRICS Leaders' Declaration to guide future cooperation and reform in multilateral bodies like the UNSC.

national_news.title: Ministry of Social Justice Expands Infrastructure and Assistive Devices for Senior Citizens
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment sanctioned 142 new Senior Citizen Homes across the country to strengthen institutional care for the elderly.
Over 23.93 lakh free assistive living devices—including wheelchairs, hearing aids, and walking sticks—were distributed across 228 camps benefiting 4.91 lakh beneficiaries.
A dedicated Senior Citizen's Welfare Portal was launched by the President of India as a single-window platform for welfare schemes and assistance information.

national_news.title: India Proposes BRICS Troika Mechanism and Governance Reforms at 18th Summit
bullets: India's BRICS Sherpa Sudhakar Dalela detailed key Indian proposals made during the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
India proposed a 'BRICS Troika' leadership mechanism between outgoing, current, and incoming chairs to ensure institutional continuity.
Proposals also emphasized expanding negotiating and legal capacities for Global South diplomats and addressing humanitarian challenges faced by stranded seafarers.

national_news.title: BRICS Leaders Adopt New Delhi Declaration and Condemn Pahalgam Terror Attack
bullets: BRICS leaders unanimously adopted the New Delhi Declaration on the opening day of the BRICS Summit hosted under India's chairship.
The bloc condemned the April 2025 terrorist attack in Pahalgam, Jammu and Kashmir, reaffirming a policy of zero tolerance for terrorism in all forms.
The declaration urged member nations to act against cross-border movement of terrorists, terror financing, safe havens, and UN-designated terrorist entities.

national_news.title: PM Modi Meets Global Leaders; UAE Announces $11.5 Billion Investment in Odisha
bullets: PM Narendra Modi held bilateral discussions with leaders of Ethiopia, Malaysia, Vietnam, and Abu Dhabi on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit 2026.
UAE's International Holding Company announced an $11.5 billion investment to establish an integrated greenfield aluminium project in Odisha.
Vietnam participated in the summit as a official Partner Country, reaffirming its strategic role as a major pillar in India's Act East Policy.

national_news.title: Second Season of Archery Premier League Scheduled in Hyderabad
bullets: The second season of the Archery Premier League (APL) will be hosted at People's Plaza in Hyderabad from October 8 to 18.
Jointly supported by the Archery Association of India and the Government of Telangana, the league features six mixed-gender franchise teams competing in Recurve and Compound categories.
The tournament incorporates a unique 15-second shot clock format, which is five seconds faster than standard Olympic timing to test speed and decision-making under pressure.

national_news.title: India's 2026 BRICS Presidency to Expand Strategic Energy and Trade Ties with Gulf
bullets: Ahead of India's 2026 BRICS Presidency, energy and investment ties with the Gulf region are expanding into clean energy, food security, and logistics.
India launched formal negotiations for a Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement with the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), covering Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain.
The inclusion of Saudi Arabia and the UAE in the expanded BRICS bloc strengthens global energy dynamics and trade security along critical routes like the Strait of Hormuz.

national_news.title: SEBI Proposes New Framework for Expiry-Day Derivative Settlement Prices
bullets: Capital markets regulator SEBI issued a consultation paper proposing changes to the methodology for calculating expiry-day settlement prices for index and stock derivatives.

The proposals offer two options: a blended Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) using the last 30 minutes of the continuous trading session and the 10-minute Closing Auction Session (CAS), or continuing the existing CTS VWAP model.
The review follows industry feedback regarding the use of the CAS framework—introduced on August 3—for derivative contract settlements on expiry days.

national_news.title: RBI Reports Robust FCNR-B Inflows and Outlines Liquidity Management Strategy
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) reported robust inflows through Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) [FCNR-B] schemes, reflecting strong investor confidence in India's macro fundamentals.

The RBI noted that surplus liquidity in the banking system will be managed via currency in circulation, forex interventions, and reserve requirements to align the weighted average call rate with the repo rate.
The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) is evaluating inflation dynamics and crude oil price movements stemming from West Asian geopolitical tensions ahead of its policy meeting.

national_news.title: Saragarhi Day Commemorates the Historic 1897 Battle of Saragarhi
bullets: Saragarhi Day was observed on September 12 to honor 21 British-Indian Sikh soldiers who made the supreme sacrifice defending Saragarhi Fort against nearly 10,000 Afghan tribesmen in 1897.
The historic battle was fought under the leadership of Havaldar Ishar Singh of the 36th Sikh Regiment in the Samana village of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (present-day Pakistan).
All 21 soldiers were posthumously awarded the Indian Order of Merit, the highest military gallantry award available to Indian soldiers at the time, which is equated to the modern Param Vir Chakra.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Chief Minister Urges Assistant Professors to Ensure 75% Student Attendance
bullets: Bihar Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary addressed newly appointed assistant professors, urging them to ensure at least 75% student attendance in degree colleges.
The state government recently established 211 new degree colleges and appointed 2,451 assistant professors to expand higher education infrastructure, particularly in rural areas.
Highlighted that Bihar spends over 21% of its total state budget on the education sector, spanning primary, secondary, and higher education.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Send 100 Professors to Oxford and Global Institutions for Training
bullets: Bihar government announced a plan to select 100 college professors and send them for 1-month training programs at Oxford and other reputed global universities.
The initiative aims to expose state educators to international teaching standards and facilitate experience-sharing with global academic experts.
The initiative was unveiled during the orientation program for 2,451 assistant professors recruited across 211 newly created degree colleges in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches Key Initiatives in Higher Education and Model Schools
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister inaugurated an orientation programme for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors across 211 newly created degree colleges, making Bihar the first state to launch 211 degree colleges in a single day.
The state announced the development of 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools to provide quality education along with NEET/JEE coaching, live classes, and 24x7 online tutoring.
An initiative was announced to send 100 selected professors for training to top global institutions including Oxford University, backed by an allocation of 21% of the state budget to education.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Launches Model School Development & Educator Training Programs
bullets: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary inaugurated an orientation program for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors across 211 degree colleges at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna.
Announced the development of 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools offering NEET and JEE competitive exam coaching, live classes, and 24x7 online tutoring.
Reiterated plans to send 100 professors to Oxford University for global exposure and professional training, supported by 21% state budget allocation for the education sector.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Sets 75% Attendance Goal and Plans Global Exposure for College Faculty
bullets: The Bihar government has established 211 new degree colleges and appointed 2,451 assistant professors to expand higher education infrastructure, especially in rural areas.
The state government announced plans to identify 100 college teachers to send abroad for one-month training courses at top international institutions.
Bihar currently allocates over 21% of its annual state budget towards the education sector, spanning primary schools to higher education institutions.
